title: NotifyNow (Legacy) - Global
content:
Returns the current status of Notify configuration. This method can only be accessed by administrators or users with the notifynow\_admin role. Users with all other roles get the message Unauthorized when trying to run the function in a script. |Name|Type|Description| |----|----|-----------| |None| | |
Type Description
String One of the possible status messages.
Status Description
NO\_NUMBER\_MESSAGE The account does not have a telephone number set up. Ensure that you set up the telephone number for the account.
NO\_ENDPOINTS\_MESSAGE The account does not have its endpoints set up correctly. Ensure that you set up the endpoints for the account.
ACCOUNT\_OK\_MESSAGE The account is active and ready for use.
ACCOUNT\_NO\_AUTH The Twilio AuthToken is not valid.
ACCOUNT\_NOT\_CONFIGURED The Twilio AccountSID or AuthToken is not valid.
``` var nn = new SNC.NotifyNow(); gs.log(nn.getStatus()); ```
